timing.why: Every lip-sync failure so far came from footage and voice being made for different recordings. The mouth must be generated FROM the final voice file.
rules: 1. Write the line: 2.3-2.6 spoken words per second of speech (6 s clip ~ 13-15 words).
2. Generate the final VO FIRST (voice.recipe). Measure its duration D (ms) from the audio node.
3. Clip length = ceil(D/1000 + 0.4) whole seconds (Seedance takes integers 3-15). Resulting silent tail 0.4-1.0 s; if the tail would exceed 1.2 s, trim or re-roll the take.
4. Render the video WITH that exact VO wired as the audio input (native lip sync). Never render first and re-sync a different or re-rolled VO later.

5. The prompt is timed to the VO: a TIMING line (lips move only from [start] to [end] s, closed and still from [end] s to the last frame) plus a SHOT BREAKDOWN with one line per phrase group and its seconds, from `python project/project_state.py beats --clip N` (syllable + punctuation-pause estimate, about +-0.3 s). Fewer gestures for a short take, more for a long one (about one per 1.5-2.5 s of speech); the closed-mouth action fills exactly the tail.
6. If VO > clip length the last word is cut; if VO < original speech in re-used footage the mouth keeps moving without sound. Both are rejects.
7. Post-lip-sync (Kling etc.) is only a rescue for a few frames, and only when the new VO starts and ends within ±0.2 s of the speech in the footage.

gravity_and_weight: Everything has weight: held bags pull the forearm down and swing a little then settle; a lifted object rises slower than it falls.
Walking: heel then toe, weight transfers with each step, head and shoulders dip 1-2 cm per step, the handheld frame bobs in rhythm; feet never slide, no gliding.
Hair: long platinum hair hangs straight when still, swings with a head turn and settles after about half a second; strands follow the stated wind direction only.
Fabric: heavy wool swings slowly and creases at elbows; nylon shells rustle and crease; knit collars sit, they do not float.
Boardwalk planks dip a few millimetres under each step; wet cobbles and paving show reflections that move with the camera.
Breathing: small chest rise; after exertion faster for the first seconds, then settles.
Cold: breath vapour only at about 5 °C or below; steam off hair/skin after sauna rises and drifts downwind and fades within a second.
Water and rain: drizzle falls straight or with the stated wind; droplets bead on waxed fabric; puddles ripple on impact.
Camera: genuine handheld phone, small shake, one autofocus breath allowed; never a gimbal, never a crane.

quality_lock.text:
QUALITY LOCK (applies to the whole take and overrides anything above that conflicts with it):
- Camera (same phone every clip): a front-camera selfie on her own phone, wide lens, held at arm's length slightly above eye level, tight framing from mid-chest up with her head in the upper third, light natural handheld shake, the same natural phone colour. She and the place are one single image through one lens: the background has the same wide-angle perspective as her face and moves together with her and the hand shake. No zoom, no dolly zoom, no background scaling or sliding separately from her, no layered or pasted look. Not a gimbal, not a tripod, not filmed by someone else.
- Identity: her face comes ONLY from her identity photo (the face reference). Copy her face shape, skin, eyes, brows, lips, hair colour and hair texture exactly as in that photo and add nothing that is not in it: no freckles, no extra moles or marks (tiny beauty marks only as faint as in the photo), no change of hair colour. Earrings, makeup, clothing, headwear and hair styling follow the scene description above; if it names no earrings, she wears none. Only the light on her changes to the light of the place. Her face stays identical from the first to the last frame; no morphing.
- One scene, one exposure: the whole frame has the same sharpness, the same level of detail, the same fine sensor grain and the same colour, contrast and white balance on her and on the background. Phone focus: her face and the background are in focus together; no shallow depth of field, no blurred background, no sharper subject on a softer background, no cut-out edges, no halo, no glow.
- Light and shadow: she is lit only by the light of the place, from the same direction, with the same softness and brightness as the surfaces around her; her face is never brighter than the scene; every shadow on her and under her falls the same way as the shadows in the scene; contact shadows where clothing, hair and props touch.
- Gravity and movement: clothing and hair have real weight and hang and move with gravity; hair and loose strands move only with the scene's wind; held objects pull down on the arm; walking has heel-to-toe weight transfer with no gliding; the background is live (people and things move naturally), never a still photo; buildings and walls stay rigid and straight.
- Framing: her fingers, the phone and her feet are never in frame unless the action says so.
- Skin: unretouched phone footage with real skin texture and pores exactly as in her identity photo; no smoothing, no beauty filter, no waxy look.
- Mouth and timing: the provided audio is her whole performance. Her lips move precisely with every word of it, from the first word to the last, and ONLY while a word is being spoken. In any silence (before the first word, in pauses, and after the last word) her lips are closed and still. After the last word her mouth closes softly and stays closed until the end of the clip; she may only smile gently with closed lips. Her voice is exactly the voice in the provided audio, same timbre, pitch and pace; never re-voiced, never faster or slower.
- Clothing and background: all clothing is completely plain, with no text, letters, logos, badges or labels anywhere. Background people stay small and far away, with stable bodies that never merge into walls or objects.
